personalities: Talks too much when nervous. Silent when afraid.
Has memorized the fastest exit from any room within thirty seconds of entering.
Refuses to use a weapon they haven't personally inspected.
Collects trinkets from every world they've visited; won't say why.
Laughs at the wrong moments. Always apologizes after.
Keeps a meticulous personal log. Encrypts it obsessively.
Distrust authority figures. Trust strangers more than they should.
Cannot stand waste — of resources, time, or people.
Operates best alone and will tell you so unprompted.
Finds comfort in machinery. People, less so.
motivations: Looking for someone who doesn't want to be found.
Paying off a debt that keeps growing.
Running from a past they can't fully remember.
Trying to finish what someone else started.
Searching for a place that doesn't exist on any map.
Protecting the only thing they have left.
Proving they're more than what they were made to be.
Buying time until they figure out what they actually want.
secrets: They witnessed something they were not supposed to survive.
They're being watched and know it, but not by whom.
A former ally is now hunting them.
They carry data someone powerful wants destroyed.
Their augmentations have a backdoor they haven't found yet.
They owe loyalty to two factions with opposing goals.
The accident that scarred them wasn't an accident.
